content.concept_description: A puzzle challenge where players attempt to connect pairs of colored dots without crossing paths, repeatedly testing routes and failing.
content.why_it_works: The IQ score framing and repeated near-miss failures trigger the viewer's desire to step in and solve the seemingly simple puzzle.

end_card.cta_and_text: 00:52 - Amaze GO! search bar with Google Play and App Store badges

gameplay.core_gameplay_notes: Connect pairs of matching colored dots using continuous lines without crossing any other lines.

chapterization.chapter_description: A man attempts to connect colored dots on a large television display.
Hand-drawn paper mockup with an Einstein IQ meter testing initial connection routes.
Repeated unsuccessful attempts with lines crossing and the IQ score rapidly dropping.
App icon, title search bar, and app store download badges.
